mainEntity.name: What is Celebrity Cruises Captain’s Club?

acceptedAnswer.text: Captain’s Club is Celebrity Cruises' free loyalty program. Members earn Club Points through qualifying sailings and eligible activities. As they accumulate points, they progress through membership tiers and receive additional benefits.

mainEntity.name: Is Celebrity Cruises Captain’s Club free to join?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Captain’s Club is free to join. Guests can enroll through the Celebrity Cruises website and manage their membership through their online account.

mainEntity.name: How many Captain’s Club tiers are there?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are six levels: Preview, Classic, Select, Elite, Elite Plus, and Zenith.

mainEntity.name: What is the highest Celebrity Cruises loyalty tier?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zenith is the highest standard Captain’s Club tier. Members need at least 3,000 Club Points to qualify through the program's normal earning rules.

mainEntity.name: How many points do you need for Celebrity Classic?
How many points do you need for Select?
How many points do you need for Elite?
How many points do you need for Elite Plus?
How many points do you need for Zenith?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zenith requires 3,000 or more Club Points.

mainEntity.name: How does Celebrity Cruises calculate Captain’s Club points?

acceptedAnswer.text: Points are primarily based on the number of nights sailed and the stateroom category purchased. Higher accommodation categories generally earn more points per night.

mainEntity.name: How many Captain’s Club points do you earn on a seven-night cruise?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the cabin. A seven-night Inside or Ocean View sailing earns 14 points, a Veranda earns 21, Concierge Class or AquaClass earns 35, and selected suites can earn between 56 and 168 points.

mainEntity.name: Do solo travelers earn double Captain’s Club points?

acceptedAnswer.text: Celebrity's published program information states that eligible solo travelers who book a stateroom and pay the full fare earn double Club Points based on their stateroom category and nights sailed.

mainEntity.name: Can you earn Captain’s Club points without cruising?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Eligible members can participate in Power Up Points activities, such as surveys and webinars. The published conversion is 10 Power Up Points for one Club Point.

mainEntity.name: What is the Go Green Bonus?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Go Green Bonus allows eligible guests who opt into reduced housekeeping to earn one additional night of points for their voyage, subject to program conditions.

mainEntity.name: Do Celebrity Captain’s Club points expire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Celebrity's published FAQ states that earned Club Points do not expire.

overview.heading: What Is Celebrity Cruises Captain’s Club?
paragraphs: Celebrity Cruises Captain’s Club is the cruise line's free loyalty program. It rewards eligible guests for sailing with Celebrity and participating in selected activities. Members earn Club Points based primarily on the number of nights sailed and the stateroom category booked.

As members accumulate points, they progress through six membership levels: Preview, Classic, Select, Elite, Elite Plus, and Zenith. Each level offers a different collection of benefits, which can include onboard events, Wi-Fi and beverage package discounts, laundry services, priority services, exclusive offers, and special milestone rewards.

The program is particularly valuable for travelers who cruise with Celebrity regularly. Benefits become more substantial at Elite and Elite Plus, while Zenith provides the highest published level of recognition.

Captain’s Club also connects with the loyalty programs of Royal Caribbean International and Silversea through a shared status-matching arrangement. This gives eligible members opportunities to enjoy recognition across three cruise brands, although points and sailing credits are governed by separate program rules.
highlights: Free Membership: No cost to join, points never expire
Six Recognition Tiers: From Preview to Zenith (3,000+ points)
Status Matching: Reciprocity with Royal Caribbean & Silversea
Valuable Privileges: Complimentary laundry, drinks & suite upgrades

earningPoints.title: How Do You Earn Celebrity Cruises Captain’s Club Points?

earningPoints.introText: Unlike airline programs that often rely on dollars spent or miles flown, Celebrity bases its core points calculation on cruise length and cabin level. The higher the stateroom category, the more points earned per night.

earningBoosters.subtitle: Three proven strategies to increase your Captain’s Club points balance faster.

cards.title: Solo Traveler Points Bonus
cards.description: Solo guests who pay the full single supplement—meaning they pay 200% of the standard stateroom fare—earn double Captain’s Club points on eligible sailings.

cards.footerNote: This double-points benefit makes Celebrity an appealing option for solo travelers looking to advance through loyalty levels faster.

cards.title: What Are Power Up Points?
cards.description: Power Up Points allow Captain’s Club members to earn loyalty points without taking a cruise. Celebrity invites members to participate in surveys, webinars, and promotional activities.

cards.footerNote: While Power Up Points do not replace cruising, they provide a convenient way to keep accumulating points between vacations.

cards.description: Celebrity’s Go Green program rewards members who choose to reduce daily housekeeping services on eligible sailings.

cards.footerNote: The bonus points contribute to your qualifying points balance and support Celebrity’s environmental sustainability efforts.

statusMatch.title: Captain’s Club Status Match: Royal Caribbean & Silversea
statusMatch.subtitle: RECIPROCAL LOYALTY STATUS MATCHING
statusMatch.intro: If you hold qualifying status with Royal Caribbean’s Crown & Anchor Society or Silversea’s Venetian Society, you may be eligible for matching recognition on Celebrity Cruises across equivalent tiers.

pointsChoice.title: Are Loyalty Points Combined Across the Three Lines? & What Is Points Choice?
pointsChoice.subtitle: Understanding how points transfer and the innovative Points Choice option.
paragraphs: By default, loyalty points are not combined into a single balance. Each program maintains its own points history and tier requirements. Status matching provides equivalent privileges on partner sailings, but your base points remain tied to the cruise line where they were earned.

Points Choice is a feature designed for guests who cruise across multiple Royal Caribbean Group brands. Under Points Choice, eligible members can choose which loyalty program receives the points earned from a sailing.

For example, a guest sailing on Celebrity can elect to direct the points earned from that cruise to their Royal Caribbean Crown & Anchor account or Silversea Venetian Society profile, subject to published conversion ratios.

table.title: Points Choice Allocation Matrix
rows: Edge Villa, Penthouse, and Reflection Suite
Royal, Signature, Celebrity, and Sunset Suites

pointsChoice.note: Points Choice gives frequent cruisers the flexibility to target status on the cruise line where they want recognition most.

expiration.title: Do Celebrity Cruises Captain’s Club Points Expire?
expiration.content: Celebrity's published Captain’s Club FAQ states that earned Club Points do not expire. This means members can continue building their points balance across qualifying cruises rather than needing to reach a new tier within a fixed annual period. However, it is still important to keep your account details accurate and check that points from completed sailings have posted correctly.

posting.title: How Long Does It Take for Captain’s Club Points to Appear?
posting.content: Celebrity's published FAQ indicates that Club Points can take up to 14 days to post after a sailing. If the points have not appeared after that period, members should contact the Captain’s Club team and provide their booking and sailing details. Keep your cruise confirmation and final booking information until the points have been credited.

howToJoin.title: How Do You Join Celebrity Cruises Captain’s Club?
howToJoin.subtitle: Joining Captain’s Club is free and the enrollment process is straightforward across five steps.

steps.title: Step 1: Create a Celebrity Cruises account
steps.description: Visit the official Celebrity Cruises website and create a guest account if you do not already have one.

steps.title: Step 2: Enroll in Captain’s Club
steps.description: Opt into the loyalty program through your account dashboard. You will receive a Captain’s Club membership number.

steps.title: Step 3: Add Your Membership Number to Your Booking
steps.description: Ensure your Captain’s Club number is attached to every Celebrity reservation prior to embarkation.

steps.title: Step 4: Complete Your Qualifying Sailing
steps.description: Sail on your cruise. Points will calculate automatically based on cruise nights and cabin category.

steps.title: Step 5: Track Your Progress
steps.description: Check your account dashboard 14 days after disembarkation to verify that your points and tier status are accurate.

tierEvaluation.title: Which Captain’s Club Tier Is Worth Reaching?
tierEvaluation.subtitle: The value of a Captain’s Club tier depends on how frequently you sail and which benefits you actually use.

personas.title: Classic: A Useful Starting Point
personas.subtitle: 2–149 Club Points
personas.description: Classic introduces members to the loyalty program and eligible member offers. It is a natural first milestone after qualifying sailing activity.

personas.title: Select: Useful for Everyday Savings
personas.subtitle: 150–299 Club Points
personas.description: Select adds meaningful Wi-Fi discounts and selected service savings. It works well for guests who take one or two cruises per year.

personas.title: Elite: A Noticeable Onboard Upgrade
personas.subtitle: 300–749 Club Points
personas.description: Elite is where the program becomes significantly more rewarding. The daily cocktail hour and complimentary laundry provide visible value on every sailing.

personas.title: Elite Plus: Strong Benefits for Frequent Cruisers
personas.subtitle: 750–2,999 Club Points
personas.description: Elite Plus is ideal for travelers who spend weeks at sea each year. The additional laundry, dining savings, and higher internet discounts add up quickly.

personas.title: Zenith: The Highest Level of Recognition
personas.subtitle: 3,000+ Club Points
personas.description: Zenith provides an exceptional cruise experience with complimentary beverage packages, unlimited Wi-Fi, full laundry service, and free milestone cruises.

tips.title: Tips for Maximizing Your Celebrity Captain’s Club Benefits
tips.subtitle: A few practical steps can help you make better use of the program.

cards.title: Enroll Before Your Next Cruise
cards.description: Join before booking or make sure your membership number is attached to your reservation. This helps prevent missing points after a sailing.

cards.title: Compare Stateroom Categories
cards.description: If you are close to a new tier, look at the difference in points earned between staterooms. Moving from a Veranda to Concierge Class increases points from 3 to 5 per night.

cards.title: Watch for Power Up Points
cards.description: Participating in online surveys, webinars, and promotional activities can add points between cruises without requiring additional travel.

cards.title: Leverage Solo Sailings
cards.description: Solo travelers paying the full single supplement receive double points, making solo cruising one of the fastest paths to Elite or Elite Plus.

cards.title: Take Advantage of Status Match
cards.description: If you sail on Royal Caribbean or Silversea, ensure your accounts are linked so you receive reciprocal benefits across all three brands.

cards.title: Book While Onboard
cards.description: Celebrity frequently offers onboard booking promotions that include reduced deposits, onboard credit, and exclusive Captain’s Club offers.

cards.title: Check Your Account After Every Cruise
cards.description: Points usually appear within 14 days. Review your account to confirm the correct points and tier level are reflected.

cards.title: Review Onboard Discounts Early
cards.description: Some benefits, such as internet and laundry discounts, can be used during your cruise. Familiarize yourself with available savings before sailing.

cards.title: Look Beyond the Loyalty Math
cards.description: Earning points is satisfying, but your vacation experience should always come first. Choose the ship, stateroom, and itinerary that fit your travel style.

sections.heading: Is Celebrity Cruises Captain’s Club Worth It?
paragraphs: Yes. Captain’s Club is worth joining if you sail with Celebrity because enrollment is free and eligible members can receive benefits as they accumulate qualifying points.

The program becomes more valuable for repeat cruisers. Classic and Select provide access to member offers and selected discounts, while Elite and Elite Plus introduce more noticeable onboard benefits. Zenith provides the highest level of recognition and additional milestone rewards.
The program is particularly attractive for travelers who regularly use services such as Wi-Fi, laundry, spa treatments, and specialty dining.

However, Captain’s Club should be treated as a loyalty reward rather than a reason to spend more than necessary. A higher stateroom category can earn more points, but the additional cruise fare should make sense independently of the loyalty calculation.

Concierge Lunch in the Main Dining Room.
Priority boarding and luggage delivery.
A complimentary seven-night Caribbean or Bermuda cruise upon reaching Zenith, subject to program terms.
Personalized Zenith benefits and milestone gifts.

acceleratorsGrid.title: Points Accelerators: Solo Travel, Power Up & Go Green
acceleratorsGrid.subtitle: Three proven strategies to increase your Captain’s Club points balance faster.
paragraphs: Beyond standard cruise nights, Celebrity provides several dedicated methods to fast-track your Captain's Club point accumulation, whether booking alone, participating in home-based activities, or choosing eco-friendly onboard options.

items.title: Solo Traveler Points Bonus
items.subtitle: DOUBLE POINTS
items.description: Solo guests who pay the full single supplement—meaning they pay 200% of the standard stateroom fare—earn double Captain’s Club points on eligible sailings. This double-points benefit makes Celebrity an appealing option for solo travelers looking to advance through loyalty levels faster.
features: Selected Sky Suite: 56 pts -> 112 pts (7 nights)

items.title: What Are Power Up Points?
items.subtitle: EARN FROM HOME
items.description: Power Up Points allow Captain’s Club members to earn loyalty points without taking a cruise. Celebrity invites members to participate in surveys, webinars, and promotional activities. While Power Up Points do not replace cruising, they provide a convenient way to keep accumulating points between vacations.
features: Conversion formula: 10 Power Up Points = 1 Captain’s Club Point

items.title: Captain’s Club Go Green Bonus
items.subtitle: ECO-FRIENDLY BONUS
items.description: Celebrity’s Go Green program rewards members who choose to reduce daily housekeeping services on eligible sailings. The bonus points contribute to your qualifying points balance and support Celebrity’s environmental sustainability efforts.
features: Opt into the Go Green program through the Celebrity App or Guest Relations
Reduce daily linen and housekeeping frequency
Earn up to 5 bonus Captain’s Club points per stateroom per sailing
Contributes directly to your qualifying points balance

milestonesTimeline.title: What Are Captain’s Club Milestone Benefits?
milestonesTimeline.subtitle: Celebrity rewards members with additional milestone privileges when they reach significant points levels above Elite and Zenith. These milestone recognitions are separate from standard tier progression and give long-time cruisers continued goals after reaching top tiers.

steps.title: 1,500 Club Points
steps.description: Complimentary bottle of champagne and access to selected onboard recognitions.

steps.title: 2,250 Club Points
steps.description: Complimentary specialty dining dinner for two and selected onboard amenity gifts.

steps.title: 3,000 Club Points (Zenith Achievement)
steps.description: Official Zenith tier status. Complimentary seven-night Caribbean or Bermuda cruise in a Veranda stateroom, complimentary Premium Drink Package, complimentary Unlimited Premium Wi-Fi, and complimentary laundry service.

steps.title: 6,000 Club Points
steps.description: An additional complimentary seven-night Caribbean or Bermuda cruise in a Veranda stateroom, plus upgraded dining and champagne gifts.

steps.title: 9,000 Club Points
steps.description: A complimentary seven-night cruise in a Sky Suite accommodation, along with enhanced onboard privileges.

tipsCards.title: Tips for Maximizing Your Celebrity Captain’s Club Benefits
tipsCards.subtitle: A few practical steps can help you make better use of the program.

cards.title: Pre-Cruise Strategy
items: Enroll Before Your Next Cruise — Join before booking or make sure your membership number is attached to your reservation. This helps prevent missing points after a sailing.

Compare Stateroom Categories — If you are close to a new tier, look at the difference in points earned between staterooms. Moving from a Veranda to Concierge Class increases points from 3 to 5 per night.
Watch for Power Up Points — Participating in online surveys, webinars, and promotional activities can add points between cruises without requiring additional travel.

cards.title: Maximizing Point Accrual
items: Leverage Solo Sailings — Solo travelers paying the full single supplement receive double points, making solo cruising one of the fastest paths to Elite or Elite Plus.
Take Advantage of Status Match — If you sail on Royal Caribbean or Silversea, ensure your accounts are linked so you receive reciprocal benefits across all three brands.
Book While Onboard — Celebrity frequently offers onboard booking promotions that include reduced deposits, onboard credit, and exclusive Captain’s Club offers.

cards.title: Onboard Savings & Long-Term Value
items: Check Your Account After Every Cruise — Points usually appear within 14 days. Review your account to confirm the correct points and tier level are reflected.
Review Onboard Discounts Early — Some benefits, such as internet and laundry discounts, can be used during your cruise. Familiarize yourself with available savings before sailing.
Look Beyond the Loyalty Math — Earning points is satisfying, but your vacation experience should always come first. Choose the ship, stateroom, and itinerary that fit your travel style.

personaCards.title: Which Captain’s Club Tier Is Worth Reaching?
personaCards.subtitle: The value of a Captain’s Club tier depends on how frequently you sail and which benefits you actually use.

personas.title: Classic: A Useful Starting Point
personas.subtitle: 2–149 Club Points
personas.description: Classic introduces members to the loyalty program and eligible member offers. It is a natural first milestone after qualifying sailing activity.

personas.title: Select: Useful for Everyday Savings
personas.subtitle: 150–299 Club Points
personas.description: Select adds meaningful Wi-Fi discounts and selected service savings. It works well for guests who take one or two cruises per year.

personas.title: Elite: A Noticeable Onboard Upgrade
personas.subtitle: 300–749 Club Points
personas.description: Elite is where the program becomes significantly more rewarding. The daily cocktail hour and complimentary laundry provide visible value on every sailing.

personas.title: Elite Plus: Strong Benefits for Frequent Cruisers
personas.subtitle: 750–2,999 Club Points
personas.description: Elite Plus is ideal for travelers who spend weeks at sea each year. The additional laundry, dining savings, and higher internet discounts add up quickly.

personas.title: Zenith: The Highest Level of Recognition
personas.subtitle: 3,000+ Club Points
personas.description: Zenith provides an exceptional cruise experience with complimentary beverage packages, unlimited Wi-Fi, full laundry service, and free milestone cruises.
